description: Read one full recipe (ingredients, steps, filing, nutrition, image) the user owns or that was shared with them, by id or name. Read-only: servings/factor/units only change what is shown; to resize for good use update_recipe. Use search_recipes to find several. Returns the recipe plus access (owner|edit|read) and shared_by for shared ones.

factor.description: Show amounts multiplied by this, e.g. 1.5

id.description: Recipe id (UUID) from search_recipes or an earlier result

include_raw.description: Also return unformatted ingredient/step objects for editing; default false

name.description: Recipe title if no id; exact (case/accent-insensitive) or a unique partial match

servings.description: Show scaled to this many servings, e.g. 2

units.description: Unit system: us (cups, oz, °F) or metric (g, ml, °C). Default us

name: get_recipe
title: Open a recipe
